Package io.github.janglada.orkit.routing

Class StopConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.janglada.orkit.routing.StopConfig
public final class StopConfig extends Object
Fluent configurator for a stop, used inside the lambda passed to RoutingBuilder.stop(String, java.util.function.Consumer).

  • Method Details

    • at

      public StopConfig at(double lat, double lon)
      Sets the geographic location of this stop (required when using haversine distances).

    • demand

      public StopConfig demand(long units)
      Sets the demand picked up or delivered at this stop in the default "load" dimension, in the same units as VehicleConfig.capacity(long). For the delivery stop of a pair, leave it unset (or equal to the pickup's demand); the load is subtracted on delivery.

    • demand

      public StopConfig demand(String dimension, long units)
      Sets the demand in a named capacity dimension (for example "kg" or "pallets"), matched against VehicleConfig.capacity(String, long). A stop may declare demand in any number of dimensions.

    • serviceTime

      public StopConfig serviceTime(Duration duration)
      Sets the dwell time the vehicle spends at this stop before departing.

    • openFrom

      public StopConfig openFrom(LocalTime time)
      Sets the earliest time-of-day the stop may be served; defaults to 00:00.

    • closeAt

      public StopConfig closeAt(LocalTime time)
      Sets the latest time-of-day the stop may be served; defaults to 23:59 (end of day).

    • requires

      public StopConfig requires(String... skills)
      Only vehicles having every listed skill (see VehicleConfig.skills(String...)) may serve this stop.

    • penaltyIfDropped

      public StopConfig penaltyIfDropped(long penalty)
      Makes this stop optional: the solver may leave it unserved at this cost, which overrides the model-wide RoutingBuilder.allowDroppingStops(long) penalty for this stop only.
      Throws:
      ModelException - if penalty is not positive

    • lateAfter

      public StopConfig lateAfter(LocalTime time, long penaltyPerMinute)
      Soft deadline: service may still start after time (up to closeAt(java.time.LocalTime)), but every minute late costs penaltyPerMinute in the objective. Turns the time dimension on.
      Throws:
      ModelException - if time is null or penaltyPerMinute is not positive
